LanguageData.PhobosCloseAirSupportPatches_SettingReal: Off by default. On: the A-10 and the Su-25 fly at speeds set by the real aircraft's, against the Harrier's. The A-10 becomes much slower, as the real one is beside a Harrier, and loses more of its speed with an engine out; the Su-25 becomes a little slower. Their take-offs, landings, turns and attack runs are unchanged. Off: the speeds the Close Air Support author set.
LanguageData.PhobosCloseAirSupportPatches_NeedsRestar: Changing this takes effect when the game next starts.
